text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um... Crown-san. Thanks for, you know, 
yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
If I hadn't bumped into Crown-san, I'm 
sure I would still be lost in the woods...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: M'sai! I'm just relieved to be back safe and sound too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...I can say this now, but... Truth be 
told, I was actually lost back then, too, 
you know?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!? R-Really? There wasn't even a 
single hint of—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I just didn't want you to see me 
flustered.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I had a rough idea of the 
direction. ...It was just a hunch, but it 
worked out, so all's well that ends well!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(S-So amazing... As expected of him. While 
I just panicked and couldn't do a single 
thing...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Yesterday, too, she shared so many 
cheerful stories with me,\nwhich kept my 
spirits up—...hm?)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... Wasn't there supposed to be a 
Satono family tea party today...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Ah... Just that, a feeling of 
familiarity...)
